messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: UseR! 2016 June (27M) 28Tu-30Th
parts:
All, 

I'm wondering about what other people's plans are for UseR this year. 

Here's the web page http://user2016.org/ 

Tutorials are on June 27 and there's a load of good ones in there, with the main talks from the 28th to 30th.

I'm fighting with my employer about going due to hotel costs ($250-$300/night in the closest ones w/o taxes). I was wondering what other's plans were about going to this meeting. I was thinking about commuting, but that would be awful and would mean missing all social activities in evenings and probably a lot of sleep in the morning to get there in time through rush hour. Is room sharing still a thing that people do?

Brandon

messages.author: d567d0ef3c054a35
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: UseR! 2016 June (27M) 28Tu-30Th
parts:
Let me draw your attention to the Coronet Motel:

http://www.coronetmotel.net/

It's on El Camino Real, just south (i.e., toward San Jose -- El Camino
changes directions in various places) of California Avenue. The place
looks like a hole in the wall, but the rooms are actually pretty nice.
We've been able to stay there for less than $200/night. It's within
walking distance of Stanford, and, better yet, it's right around the
corner from Izzy's Brooklyn Bagels:

http://www.izzysbrooklynbagels.com/

There are lots of nice restaurants on California Avenue, within easy
walking distance of the motel.

Note, by the way, that the Coronet is a tiny place, so if you're
interested you should probably book a room ASAP.

-- Mike
